title: Move marketing behave specs and TS harnesses to Chattic.us-web

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Move to Chattic.us-web: harnesses marketing-ui-harness.tsx,
contact-form-harness.ts, survey-form-harness.ts, analytics-harness.ts from
web/test-support/. Features: beta_pitch, marketing_beta_pitch,
beta_waitlist_marketing_funnel, contact_forms, delegation_ladder_positioning,
waitlist_survey*, page_content_authority, and their step files from
features/steps/. Keep behave as the runner, per the answered question on this
epic.

Do not delete the originals from this repository until the migrated specs pass
green in Chattic.us-web — see this epic's verification section.
